arguments.purpose: Screen external primary technical documentation and pinned emulator-source excerpts before using their VU/VIF control-flow semantics.
arguments.text:
Sony Computer Entertainment, VU User’s Manual Version 6.0, §3.4, Figure 3-19: The E bit marks the end of a micro subroutine. One E-bit delay instruction executes; afterward execution stops and TPC stores the address of the following instruction. XTOP cannot be placed in the delay slot.

Pinned PCSX2 commit 81526d4dc7cc70e4ae75abb35a789417456c6d43, Vif_Codes.cpp: VIF1 execMicro sets TOP = TOPS & 0x3ff, then updates TOPS according to DBF, BASE, OFFSET. `vifCode_MSCNT` calls `vuExecMicro(idx, -1, false)`. `vifCode_Offset` clears DBF and sets TOPS=BASE; `vifCode_Base` writes BASE; `vifCode_STMod` writes MODE; `vifCode_STCycl` writes CL/WL.

Raw overlay-5 pairs: pair 213 at 0x2ea8 is E-marked nop, pair 214 at 0x2eb0 is a nop delay slot, pair 215 at 0x2eb8 is `xtop vi01`.

Static FUN_00128e88 output-buffer stores advance the shared cursor. The tail order is STMOD 0; STCYCL 4/4; MSCNT; BASE 0x3aa or 0x388; OFFSET 0. The BASE/OFFSET stores occur after MSCNT.
